summary: Lao People's Democratic Republic. Communist party-led state.
rulers: President THONGLOUN Sisoulith (since 22 March 2021); Prime Minister SONEXAY (also spelled SONXAI) Siphandon (since 30 December 2022)
economy: lower middle-income, industrial Southeast Asian economy; high inflation due to 2022 currency depreciation brought on by persistently high debt; new Laos-China railway and dry port; rising inequities; ongoing labor shortages GDP (PPP): $66.905 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Lao People's Armed Forces (LPAF; aka Lao People's Army): Lao People's Army (LPA, includes Riverine Force), Lao People's Air Force (LPAF); Self-Defense Militia Forces (2025) Expenditure: 0.2% of GDP (2019 est.)
origin: 19 July 1949 (from France); 22 October 1953 (Franco-Lao Treaty recognizes full independence)
